$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'

$statePath=Join-Path $blog 'publishing-state.json'
$s=Get-Content $statePath -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json -DateKind String
$r=Get-Content (Join-Path $blog 'publishing-review-2026-10-08.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json -DateKind String

foreach($id in @('141','142')) {

 $a.sourceCommit='3027a1aac9a5cea2d625c94cefe2239a372dd060'
 $a.featureStatus='partial';$a.lastReviewedAt=[DateTimeOffset]::Now.ToString('o');$a.lastError=$null
 $a.contentSha256=(Get-FileHash (Join-Path 'D:\source\SonnetDB' $a.path) -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
 $a|Add-Member -NotePropertyName reviewSourceCommit -NotePropertyValue $a.sourceCommit -Force
 $a|Add-Member -NotePropertyName publicDocumentationCommit -NotePropertyValue 'c785f0479686a3d6584787e1a2b40bd67b0e38c5' -Force
 $a.notes='2026-10-08 源码/专题/发行物复核并补完整操作、结果解释和边界；开发树切片不冒称4.0.0包能力；示例未实跑，发布保留默认社区footer。'
 $sources=@()
 foreach($d in $a.sourceDocs) { $p=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $blog $d));$body=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($p);$sources+=@{path=$d;chars=$body.Length;sha256=(Get-FileHash $p -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()} }
 $reviews+=@{articleId=$id;contentSha256=$a.contentSha256;sourceDocs=$sources;reviewedAt=$a.lastReviewedAt}
}
$s.updatedAt='2026-10-08'
$r|Add-Member -NotePropertyName manuscriptReviews -NotePropertyValue $reviews -Force
$r|Add-Member -NotePropertyName publicDocumentationCommit -NotePropertyValue 'c785f0479686a3d6584787e1a2b40bd67b0e38c5' -Force
$r|Add-Member -NotePropertyName deduplication -NotePropertyValue @{checkedArticleCount=$s.articles.Count;checkedExternalCount=$s.externalPublishedArticles.Count;accountHomepageShowsYesterdayLatest=$true;matchedQueuedTitles=0;historicalUnconfirmedPaused=59;scope='known published titles/topics plus prior 90-entry account reconciliation and current homepage; no hidden-account absence claim'} -Force
$r|Add-Member -NotePropertyName factSources -NotePropertyValue @('web/src/router/index.ts','web/src/utils/writeApproval.ts','extensions/sonnetdb-vscode/src/core/sonnetdbClient.ts','extensions/sonnetdb-vscode/package.json','src/SonnetDB.Core/Storage/Segments/SegmentWriter.cs','src/SonnetDB.Core/Storage/Segments/SegmentReader.cs','src/SonnetDB.Core/Engine/SegmentReplacementManifest.cs','src/SonnetDB.Core/Memory/MemTable.cs','src/SonnetDB.Core/Memory/MemTableSeries.cs','tests/SonnetDB.Benchmarks/Program.cs','eng/m43-release-evidence.template.json','eng/verify-m43-release-evidence.ps1','ROADMAP.md','docs/design/m47-unified-management-workbench/validation-report.md') -Force
$facts=@();foreach($f in $r.factSources) {$facts+=@{path=$f;sha256=(Get-FileHash (Join-Path 'D:\source\SonnetDB' $f) -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()}}
$r|Add-Member -NotePropertyName factSourceHashes -NotePropertyValue $facts -Force
$enc=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
foreach($entry in @(@{path=$statePath;value=$s},@{path=(Join-Path $blog 'publishing-review-2026-10-08.json');value=$r})) {
 $tmp=$entry.path+'.cnblogs-20261008-1100.tmp'
 try {[IO.File]::WriteAllText($tmp,(($entry.value|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 30).Replace(\"`r`n\",\"`n\")+\"`n\"),$enc);[IO.File]::Move($tmp,$entry.path,$true)} finally {if([IO.File]::Exists($tmp)){[IO.File]::Delete($tmp)}}
}
& docs/blogs/.publish-run-20261008/session.ps1 -Mode probe
& docs/blogs/.publish-run-20261008/session.ps1 -Mode dry -ArticleId 141"
